dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_lateral_movement_lateral_movement_170", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "dstport" IN (22) AND "value" > 0
